label: Step 4 negative control, run before any StudySS2 data exists. 25 CODA-LM Val scenes x 3 tasks, references PERMUTED by one position so each prediction is another scene reference.
VERDICT: THE JUDGE FAILS THE NEGATIVE CONTROL. This is a STOPPING CONDITION on the CODA-LM per-task means, not a caveat.
why_the_identity_control_could_not_have_: a judge that always answers 10 scores 75 of 75 identity pairs at exactly 10.0 with zero variance too. The identity arm proves a 10 CAN be produced; only the permutation shows what a 10 MEANS. Same structure as the prefix-cache pair, where 0 hits on 6,702,660 queried tokens meant nothing until the same-salt arm showed a hit would register.

result.gap: identity 10.00 against mismatched 6.88 is only 3.12 points of a 10-point scale.
result.the_worst_single_fact: 10 of 74 mismatched pairs scored EXACTLY 10.0. The judge awarded full marks to a reference answer describing a DIFFERENT driving scene.

THE_PREREGISTERED_CUT_IS_INVALIDATED.finding: 50 of 74 mismatched references, 68 percent, score at or above 6.0. By task: general 18 of 25 at 72 percent, regional 16 of 24 at 67 percent, suggestion 16 of 25 at 64 percent.
THE_PREREGISTERED_CUT_IS_INVALIDATED.consequence: a 2x2 built at the pre-registered cut would classify roughly two thirds of completely mismatched content as correct. The 2x2 cannot be built at 6.0.
THE_PREREGISTERED_CUT_IS_INVALIDATED.what_I_am_NOT_doing: raising the cut after seeing this. Moving a pre-registered threshold once the distribution is known is precisely what pre-registration forbids, and it is the error that moved a StudySS1 headline 17 points. The cut is reported as INVALIDATED BY THE CONTROL and the 2x2 is withheld, rather than silently re-chosen.
THE_PREREGISTERED_CUT_IS_INVALIDATED.note: the control also shows WHY no cut rescues it: the judge usable range is compressed to roughly 7 to 10, so mismatched and correct content are not separable by any threshold on this scale.

consequence_for_the_per_task_means: the CODA-LM per-task 1-10 means CANNOT be reported as quality. Mismatched content sits at 6.88, so a model answer at 7 is indistinguishable from a reference describing another scene. The identity ceiling at 10.0 was SATURATION rather than calibration, exactly as the third anticipated outcome described.

length_test_BANDED.why_banding_was_required: the permuted spread is wide, 1 to 10, so "wrong by construction" is only approximately true: CODA-LM is driving scenes and permuted descriptions overlap heavily, so quality is NOT constant across the set and a raw within-set length gradient is confounded by accidental relevance.
length_test_BANDED.the_confound_is_real: pearson r(prediction words, mismatched rating) = +0.232, so longer mismatched predictions do score higher, consistent with more chances to overlap something true.
length_test_BANDED.raw_ungarded_gradient: +1.583 from short to long tercile, which is mostly the confound.
length_test_BANDED.reading: with quality held by banding, the length effect largely disappears, from +1.583 raw to between 0.000 and +0.375 within bands.

normalised_comparison_against_EGOTHINK.egothink: +0.181 on a 0/0.5/1 scale with a usable range of 1.0, i.e. 0.181 of range, on a prompt with NO anti-length instruction
normalised_comparison_against_EGOTHINK.codalm: about +0.3 on a usable range of roughly 3 points (7 to 10), i.e. about 0.10 of range, on a prompt that explicitly instructs the judge to ignore length
normalised_comparison_against_EGOTHINK.direction: CODA-LM normalised effect is SMALLER, which is the INTERPRETABLE direction: a smaller effect is clean evidence the explicit instruction helps, whereas a larger one would have been ambiguous between a failing instruction and a scale with more granularity for the same bias to express itself.
normalised_comparison_against_EGOTHINK.caveat: this is secondary. It characterises a judge that has just failed its negative control, so it bears on judge design rather than on any CODA-LM result.

length_test_BANDED.granularity_note: 0/0.5/1 has three attainable values against ten, so a length effect has more room to express itself on the 1-10 scale before saturating. That is why only the smaller direction is clean.

per_task_observation: accidental relevance was expected to be highest on suggestion, generic driving advice transferring across scenes, and lowest on regional. The means do not show that: regional is highest at 7.12 and suggestion lowest at 6.56. So the transfer is not driven by the genericity of the text in the way predicted.
what_would_be_needed: a judge that separates mismatched from correct content on this task. Candidates not pursued here: a larger judge, the GPT-4 the paper used, or a prompt change. All are methodological and belong to the user.
split_caveat: CODA-LM Val references fetched directly under Apache-2.0. If StudySS2 stages a different split, this control must be re-run against the staged references.
